title: Remaping L-CTRL to L-WIN makes R-ALT behave like WIN+ALT, making keyboard manager unusable for Norwegians.

judgment.rationale: The issue supplies a deterministic Norwegian-layout reproduction: map Left Ctrl to Left Win, then press Right Alt+4, which should type `$` but instead opens the taskbar context menu as if Win+Alt+4 were pressed. Runtime code tracks right-Alt/AltGr state, but no test covers this modifier-remap combination; the root cause remains unconfirmed.
evidence: The report specifies PowerToys 0.69.0, Norwegian NNO/NB layout, exact remap, and RAlt+4 sequence.
The observed result is a taskbar context menu rather than the `$` character.
The issue has no comments or assignees; #31042 is related but not an established fix.
judgment.recommended_action: Add a native regression for the exact AltGr plus Ctrl-to-Win event sequence and trace modifier classification.

fix_assessment.rationale: AltGr/right-Alt state may be reinterpreted as a Win/Alt combination after left-Ctrl remapping, but current evidence does not identify the exact translation branch.

proposed_fixes.title: Preserve Norwegian AltGr semantics when Left Ctrl is remapped to Left Win
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The remapped left-Ctrl-to-Win state may leak into the right-Alt/AltGr chord and cause the OS to receive Win+Alt+4 rather than a layout-generated `$`. This is a testable hypothesis, not a confirmed root cause.
plan: Add an event-stream regression for Norwegian AltGr+4 with Left Ctrl→Left Win enabled, including the exact scan/VK sequence and key-up order.
Trace right-Alt/AltGr detection and modifier remapping in KeyboardEventHandlers.cpp to find where the logical Win modifier becomes part of the AltGr chord.
Adjust only the confirmed modifier translation so physical AltGr remains an AltGr text-input chord while explicit remappings retain their documented behavior.
Add adjacent tests for unremapped AltGr, other AltGr-generated characters, and ordinary Win shortcuts.
verification: With Left Ctrl→Left Win active on Norwegian NNO/NB, RAlt+4 produces `$` and does not invoke a Windows shell action.
Unremapped AltGr behavior and normal left-Ctrl-to-Win remaps remain unchanged.
The regression test covers both press and release ordering.

confidence.rationale: The trigger is precise and the runtime has AltGr state handling, but no test or trace currently proves that the remapped Win state is the failure source.

issue_context.summary: On a Norwegian layout, mapping Left Ctrl to Left Win makes Right Alt+4 open the taskbar context menu instead of typing `$`.
known_information: Reported on PowerToys 0.69.0, GitHub installation, not elevated.
The issue gives exact steps and expected/actual behavior, with an optional reverse mapping also mentioned.
No comments or direct linked work are present; #31042 is related.
inferences: Right Alt+4 is an AltGr-generated character chord and may be mishandled after a Win modifier remap.
Existing AltGr state handling is relevant but does not confirm a code cause.
issue_context.analysis: The supplied steps are sufficient for a maintainer-side replay, so no reporter request is needed. A native event-sequence test can determine whether the interaction is in AltGr classification or another modifier path.
initial_investigation: Read the full live issue body and confirmed no comments or assignees.
Checked linked reports and focused Keyboard Manager runtime/history, including existing AltGr state handling.
Reviewed OSLevelShortcutRemappingTests.cpp; it covers AltGr state but not this exact Ctrl-to-Win remap combination.

actions.label: Replay Norwegian AltGr+4 with Ctrl-to-Win mapping

reproduce.title: Test AltGr character entry after Left Ctrl is remapped to Left Win
prerequisites: Current upstream main or current build
Norwegian NNO or NB keyboard layout
steps: Map Left Ctrl to Left Win and enable Keyboard Manager.
Open Notepad and focus a text field with the Norwegian layout active.
Press Right Alt+4 and record the text and any shell action.
Repeat with the mapping disabled and capture the native keyboard event sequence if the behavior differs.
reproduce.expected_result: Right Alt+4 types `$` in both cases and never opens the taskbar context menu.
